subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack dependency path be split into a separate canonical issue?
rationale: The active PR covers only the sanitizer slice, while the remaining dependency/auth-stack path touches provider auth and dependency policy where automation should not choose the long-term fix shape alone.

options.title: Keep Canonical For Both Slices
options.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path until live proof or a split follow-up exists.

options.title: Split Auth-Stack Path Now
options.body: Move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a focused canonical follow-up and let this issue close only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Override Sanitizer Proof Only
options.body: A provider owner can accept source-level sanitizer proof, but the close decision should still preserve the separate ADC reproduction somewhere durable.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical For Both Slices
recommendation.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path until live proof or a split follow-up exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged production ADC support in the native google-vertex path, which is the highest-risk remaining auth-stack surface.
